assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: one standalone square product advertising artwork for a premium desktop ecommerce activity-preview gallery.
Primary request: Create an exquisite high-end creative-agency conceptual campaign photograph of warm ivory wireless earbuds and their open charging case, composed within a sculptural folded translucent amber acoustic membrane.
Scene/backdrop: warm pale parchment seamless studio, a simple carefully considered physical sculpture of thin translucent amber material curling like a single sculptural sound wave.
Subject: one beautifully designed unbranded ivory charging case open, with two distinct small ivory earbuds naturally seated or gently floating immediately above it; realistic precise product engineering and readable recognizable silhouette.
Style/medium: museum-grade experimental editorial product photography, hyperreal premium materials, gallery art direction, physically credible refraction and tactile matte finish. Quiet luxury.
Composition/framing: SQUARE 1:1 canvas, product centered within central 70%, generous breathing room, readable at small ecommerce card scale, amber sculpture elegantly wraps behind and below without obscuring product. Hero product complete within safe central 80%.
Lighting/mood: soft sunrise amber transmitted light, subtle warm refraction, precise long studio shadows, sophisticated calm.
Color palette: ivory, pale parchment, honey amber, very restrained.
Constraints: No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no branding, no UI. One concept, one scene, one product category. Product advertising image only.
Avoid: neon, glowing sci-fi trails, purple, busy background, explosion, duplicate products, cropped product, human hands, collage, poster layout.
assets.qa: Pass: distinct ivory earbuds and case; amber sculptural membrane; complete central hero; no text/logos/watermarks.

assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: one standalone SQUARE 1:1 product advertising artwork for a premium desktop ecommerce activity-preview gallery.
Primary request: an exquisite conceptual campaign photograph of one unbranded brushed titanium compact camera with a substantial black lens, floating inside a clean architectural frame made from a single bent mirror.
Scene/backdrop: oxblood burgundy seamless studio. Single thick polished silver mirror sheet bends into an elegant angular open architectural portal, with carefully controlled reflections of the camera and dark burgundy atmosphere.
Subject: one premium compact camera, brushed silver titanium body, detailed black optical lens, minimal believable control dials, precise engineering, no lettering or logos. Camera occupies central 55 percent and is wholly readable, three-quarter frontal view.
Style/medium: top creative-agency gallery-grade surreal product photography, conceptual design studio campaign, ultra-real material fidelity, quiet sophisticated visual tension.
Composition/framing: SQUARE canvas, entire camera fully inside central 80%, single sculptural mirror frame forms an angular cradle around the camera without obstructing lens or body, clean deliberate negative space. Strong graphic geometry and one hero product. One scene.
Lighting/mood: sharp museum lighting from above-left, cinematic sculptural shadows, silver highlights, deep rich burgundy background, credible controlled mirror reflections.
Color palette: oxblood, burgundy, titanium silver, black; minimal restrained palette.
Constraints: absolutely no text, no logos, no lettering, no watermark, no human figures, no UI, no typography. Camera and frame only. Reflections may show partial camera reflections naturally but only one actual camera.
Avoid: rainy street, neon, glowing sci-fi lines, busy wireframe, liquid splash, explosion, repeated cameras, collages, image panels, cropped product.
assets.qa: Pass: one titanium camera; burgundy backdrop and bent mirror frame; reflected details physically coherent; complete central hero; no text/logos/watermarks.
